-- Получаем информацию об оценивающем и оцениваемом для определения уровня доступа
WITH evaluator_info AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    role,
    manager_id,
    has_subordinates
  FROM performance_db.users 
  WHERE id = {{ $json.evaluator_id }}
),
subject_info AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    manager_id
  FROM performance_db.users 
  WHERE id = {{ $json.subject_id }}
),
-- Проверяем, является ли оценивающий менеджером менеджера оцениваемого
subject_manager AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    manager_id
  FROM performance_db.users 
  WHERE id = (SELECT manager_id FROM subject_info)
)
SELECT 
  e.role as evaluator_role,
  e.has_subordinates,
  s.manager_id as subject_manager_id,
  sm.manager_id as subject_manager_manager_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN e.role IN ('admin', 'c_level') THEN 'c_level'
    WHEN e.id = sm.manager_id THEN 'mid_level'
    ELSE 'none'
  END as correction_level
FROM evaluator_info e
CROSS JOIN subject_info s
LEFT JOIN subject_manager sm ON true

INSERT INTO performance_db.score_corrections 
  (subject_id, evaluator_id, criteria_id, correction_score, correction_level, updated_at)
VALUES 
  ({{ $json.subject_id }}, {{ $json.evaluator_id }}, {{ $json.criteria_id }}, {{ $json.correction_score }}, '{{ $json.correction_level }}', NOW())
ON CONFLICT (subject_id, criteria_id, correction_level) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  correction_score = EXCLUDED.correction_score,
  evaluator_id = EXCLUDED.evaluator_id,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, correction_score, correction_level
